spec.code:
/-- The drive a folder or file lives in; a drive is its own. -/
def driveOf (db : model.Db) : model.Resource → Option U64
  | .Folder x => (db.folders.val.find? (·.id = x)).map (·.drive_id)
  | .File x => (db.files.val.find? (·.id = x)).map (·.drive_id)
  | .Drive x => some x
  | _ => none

spec.name: driveRow
spec.code: def driveRow (db : model.Db) (d : U64) : Option model.Drive := db.drives.val.find? (·.id = d)

spec.name: isStorage
spec.code:
def isStorage : model.Resource → Bool
  | .Folder _ | .File _ => true
  | _ => false

def grantapi.transition
  (db : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : Std.U64)
  (req : grantapi.Request) :
  Result (model.Db × (core.result.Result grantapi.Reply model.ErrorKind))
  := do
  match req with
  | grantapi.Request.CreateGrant resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.create_grant db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.SetRole resource subject role expires_at =>
    grantapi.set_role_handler db env caller resource subject role expires_at
  | grantapi.Request.RevokeGrant grant_id =>
    grantapi.revoke_grant db env caller grant_id

import Spec
import H5iAppLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec H5iAppLib

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Solution

@[simp] theorem folder_clone (f : model.Folder) : model.Folder.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone f = ok f := by
  unfold model.Folder.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone
  have hcl : ∀ x : U64, core.clone.CloneU64.clone x = ok x := by intro x; rfl
  have hvec := H5iAppLib.vec_clone_ok core.clone.CloneU64 f.lpath hcl
  simp [lift, hvec]

@[step] theorem folder_clone_step (f : model.Folder) :
    model.Folder.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone f ⦃ f' => f' = f ⦄ := by
  simp [folder_clone]

@[step] theorem find_folder_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.find_folder db id ⦃ o => o = db.folders.val.find? (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.find_folder acl.find_folder_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.folders.val (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) (fun o : Option model.Folder => o)
    (fun _ f => some f) none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_find _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.find_folder_loop.body; h5i_step

@[step] theorem find_file_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.find_file db id ⦃ o => o = db.files.val.find? (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.find_file acl.find_file_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.files.val (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) (fun o : Option model.File => o)
    (fun _ f => some f) none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_find _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.find_file_loop.body; h5i_step

def defaultDrivePolicies : model.DrivePolicies :=
  {
    read_only := false,
    forbid_sharing := false,
    forbid_external_sharing := false,
    forbid_public_links := false,
    forbid_owner_role_change := false
  }

theorem search_findD {α β} (l : List α) (P : α → Bool) (f : α → β) (d : β) (r : β)
    (hr : r = searchFrom l P (fun _ x => f x) d (↑(0#usize : Usize))) :
    r = ((l.find? P).map f).getD d := by
  rw [hr, searchFrom_findD, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero]

@[step] theorem drive_policies_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.drive_policies db id ⦃ p => p = ((db.drives.val.find? (fun d => decide (d.id = id))).map (·.policies)).getD defaultDrivePolicies ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.drive_policies acl.drive_policies_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.drives.val (fun d => decide (d.id = id)) (fun p : model.DrivePolicies => p)
    (fun _ d => d.policies) defaultDrivePolicies _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_findD _ _ _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.drive_policies_loop.body; h5i_step [defaultDrivePolicies]

@[step] theorem drive_of_storage (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource) (hst : isStorage r = true) :
    acl.drive_of db r ⦃ o => o = driveOf db r ⦄ := by
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hst
  · unfold acl.drive_of driveOf
    step*
    all_goals (simp only [Option.map]; split <;> simp_all)
  · unfold acl.drive_of driveOf
    step*
    all_goals (simp only [Option.map]; split <;> simp_all)

@[step] theorem policies_for_storage (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource) (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive)
    (hst : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr) :
    grantapi.policies_for db r ⦃ res => res = core.result.Result.Ok dr.policies ⦄ := by
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage] at hst
  · unfold grantapi.policies_for
    step*
    · rfl
    · simp only [driveRow] at hr; simp_all
  · unfold grantapi.policies_for
    step*
    · rfl
    · simp only [driveRow] at hr; simp_all

theorem is_drive_storage (r : model.Resource) (hst : isStorage r = true) :
    grantapi.is_drive r = ok false := by
  cases r <;> simp [isStorage, grantapi.is_drive] at *

theorem create_gates_respects_sharing_policies
    (db : model.Db) (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject)
    (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hst : isStorage r = true)
    (hd : driveOf db r = some d) (hr : driveRow db d = some dr)
    (u : Unit)
    (hg : grantapi.create_gates db r s = ok (core.result.Result.Ok u)) :
    dr.policies.forbid_sharing = false ∧ (∀ t, s = .Token t → dr.policies.forbid_public_links = false) := by
  have hpol := eq_ok_of_spec (policies_for_storage db r d dr hst hd hr)
  have hisd := is_drive_storage r hst
  unfold grantapi.create_gates at hg
  rw [hpol] at hg
  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok, ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at hg
  rcases hg with ⟨_, rfl, w, hw, hg⟩
  dsimp only at hw
  simp only [ok.injEq] at hw
  subst hw
  rw [hisd] at hg
  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok, ok.injEq] at hg
  rcases hg with ⟨_, rfl, hg⟩
  simp only [reduceCtorEq, ite_false] at hg
  by_cases hsh : dr.policies.forbid_sharing = true
  · simp [hsh, ok.injEq] at hg
  · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hsh
    refine ⟨hsh, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    subst ht
    simp only [hsh, reduceCtorEq, if_false, bind_tc_eq_ok, ok.injEq] at hg
    rcases hg with ⟨_, rfl, hg⟩
    simp only [if_true] at hg
    by_cases hpub : dr.policies.forbid_public_links = true
    · simp [hpub, ok.injEq] at hg
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hpub
      exact hpub

theorem create_respects_sharing_policies (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (d : U64) (dr : model.Drive) (hst : isStorage r = true) (hd : driveOf db r = some d)
    (hr : driveRow db d = some dr)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    dr.policies.forbid_sharing = false ∧ (∀ t, s = .Token t → dr.policies.forbid_public_links = false) := by
  unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
  simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  rcases h with ⟨r1, _, h1⟩
  cases r1 with
  | Err err =>
    simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨_, _, _, hfalse⟩
    cases hfalse
  | Ok u1 =>
    simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨r2, hgates, h2⟩
    cases r2 with
    | Err err =>
      simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at h2
      rcases h2 with ⟨_, _, _, hfalse⟩
      cases hfalse
    | Ok u2 =>
      exact create_gates_respects_sharing_policies db r s d dr hst hd hr u2 hgates

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution
